| [CLAIM-375](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-375.md) v4 | Granting influence to allies pays | The demonstrated core of [CLAIM-285](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-285.md). Under A3's one-hop rule I_j = I_j⁰ + Σ_(k≠j) b_k E_kj, with budgets and baselines fixed within an epoch ([CLAIM-282](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-282.md)), an operator's authority does not respond to its own grants. If the collective decision is the authority-weighted mean of the operators' policies, then granting influence to an ally whose policy is nearer one's own than the decision is moves the decision strictly toward one's policy.
